goal: The feed will shift to about 69 wt % ethylene and the unit needs about 25 % more ethylene from this tower at polymer-grade purity. Find what limits the tower, propose the change, and make the design pass every engineering check, including the documented product purity spec (ethane in the ethylene product at most 0.1 wt %) and the +10 % feed operating envelope.

result.headline: Re-tray in same shell passes all checks

needs_human: Tray vendor hydraulic capacity factor and Murphree efficiency at 22.9 bar ethylene/ethane service: If capacity <1.6 flood would exceed 85% at 1.25×; if efficiency <0.82 purity would need higher reflux
Refrigeration condenser and reboiler duties at 1.25× (38.7 MW condenser, 29.2 MW reboiler): If duty limit <31 MW, reflux 5.2 cannot be sustained - would need feed pre-cool or lower reflux
Actual future feed composition and rate: If ethylene <65 wt% bottom load increases; if feed >115 t/h flood rises to 92% at 126.5 t/h
